name: ramp
description: Work with the Ramp corporate spend platform: developer API, spend analysis, and the official Ramp MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Query Ramp spend data: transactions, cards, reimbursements, reporting.
interface.longDescription: Connects Caeros to Ramp's official hosted MCP server (mcp.ramp.com) with your own Ramp account via OAuth, and adds three developer skills: the Ramp developer API (OAuth flows, scopes, transactions, cards, reimbursements), read-only spend analysis and reporting patterns, and developer app setup with sandbox testing. Access mirrors your Ramp role. Built for analysis and integration work; it does not move money or initiate payments.
defaultPrompt: Pull last month's Ramp transactions and summarize spend by merchant
Set up OAuth for the Ramp developer API with the right scopes
Find Ramp transactions missing receipts or memos and draft reminders
